stage.plain: How far the cancer has spread. Higher numbers mean it has spread further.

lymph nodes.plain: Small bean-shaped glands that filter fluid. Doctors check them to see if cancer cells have travelled.

pathology.plain: The lab's study of the tissue taken out in surgery.

chemotherapy.plain: Strong medicine that kills fast-growing cells, including cancer cells.

FOLFOX.plain: The name of a chemotherapy mix of three medicines, given through a vein.

infusion.plain: Medicine given slowly through a thin tube into a vein.

neuropathy.plain: Tingling, numbness or pain, often in the hands and feet.
